summary: A man in New Mexico hid in a crawlspace after finding a bear that fatally mauled his stepfather.
A young person was attacked by a coati in Cerro de la Silla, requiring stitches.
Two black bear cubs were killed in a vehicle collision near Goldstream Park.
Two bear cubs were struck and killed by a vehicle on a highway near a B.C. provincial park.

A bear was spotted on camera in Newcastle, California, where it knocked over a neighbor's trash and destroyed a fence. This was the first time a bear had been seen on the property in over three decades.
Officials in British Columbia report that four grizzly bears were responsible for the killing of a mother and daughter.
A woman suffered bloody injuries from an attack by a wild carnivore (nutria) in Lake Tahoe.
A swim instructor at Lake Tahoe recounts being attacked by a river otter, requiring 38 stitches.
A woman in British Columbia saved her pet goat from a violent attack by a cougar, which resulted in the goat's death.
